text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф seems to be the name on

everybody's lips, but she only comes
second in
the fan poll.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Resolving to deliver a performance that
will
convince the holdouts of her
strength, the two of
us leave the waiting
room to face the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
